title: Dverger circlet

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Dverger circlet is an armor piece. It grants the player a never-ending light source when equipped in the form of a cone wherever the player is looking.
The circlet provides 2 armor, and its light source negates any sneak bonus while equipped. The circlet cannot be worn concurrently with any other head armor.
The circlet can be attached to surfaces with item stands to be used as a light source that does not need refueling.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text: It can be purchased from Haldor for 620 Coins.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: "Dvergr" is the Old Norse word for "dwarf".
